title: Shared definitions for the edh-companion project files

schema_version.description: Contract version. Minor bumps only add optional fields.

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). null when unknown; never guessed.

evidence_class.description: verified_fact: read from an authoritative source (Scryfall, Wizards, Spellbook, Comprehensive Rules). calculated: computed from verified data by a script or tool. popularity_metric: usage statistics (EDHREC, decklist counts) with a sample size. community_opinion: what players or creators say. model_assessment: Claude's own judgment. unresolved: not established.

name.description: Exact Scryfall card name (front face name for double-faced cards is acceptable only if it resolves).

oracle_id.description: Scryfall oracle_id: identifies the card across printings.

printing_id.description: Scryfall card id: identifies one printing. Required when the theme depends on art or a specific printing.

deck_hash.description: From deck_check.py: hash of the sorted card names and quantities (printings excluded). Changes whenever the list changes.

printings_hash.description: Hash including set and collector number; changes when a printing changes.

evidence_refs.description: IDs of sources, findings or audit checks that support a statement.

next_steps.description: Concrete next steps worth offering the player, recommended first. May be empty.

follow_up_questions.description: Questions whose answers materially change the work. May be empty.

advice.description: Recommendations with their reasons. May be empty.
